blocks.text: Cloud Connector groups are comprised of individual Cloud Connectors and are used to configure policy rules in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Cloud Connector groups provide the following benefits and allow you to:

blocks.item: Apply policies to a group of deployed Cloud Connectors.
Upgrade Cloud Connectors belonging to a group to maintain redundancy while upgrades are being executed.

blocks.text: You can create and update Cloud Connector groups in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Zscaler Cloud Connector.

blocks.heading: About the Cloud Connector Groups Page

blocks.text: On the Cloud Connector Groups page (Private Access > Private Infrastructure > Cloud Connector Groups), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the Cloud Connector group information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Refresh the Cloud Connector Groups page to reflect the most current information.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.

View a list of all deployed Cloud Connector groups. Click the name of the Cloud Connector group to open the Cloud Connector Group Details drawer where you can view additional details about the Cloud Connector group.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
